items.problem: Compiled bindings (x:Bind / x:DataType) fail with WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType' / WMC1111 / WMC9999 internal compiler error when the project is left with an inconsistent root namespace (SDK sample's 'SDKTemplate' vs the new project name), because x:Bind resolves types by CLR namespace.
items.evidence: migration-score.json build_error ('WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario + WMC1111 x:DataType missing + WMC9999 internal compiler error in MainPage.xaml'); code inspection: MainPage.xaml.cs + SampleConfiguration.cs are namespace 'SDKTemplate' while Scenario*.cs are 'CustomUsbDeviceAccess'.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### x:Bind and compiled bindings' section (~line 683), which currently only mentions XLS0414/MC3074 'type was not found' from stale UWP namespace prefixes.
items.proposed_improvement: Sharpen the existing x:Bind section to also cover WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 and add the rule: keep C# namespace, x:Class, and xmlns:local="using:..." consistent project-wide; do not partially rename an SDK sample's root namespace (e.g. SDKTemplate) to the new project name, since x:Bind/x:DataType resolve model types by CLR namespace.
items.generalizes: Every migrated UWP SDK sample in this benchmark family uses a shared 'SDKTemplate' root namespace that differs from the scaffolded project name; any DataTemplate using x:Bind/x:DataType will fail identically whenever the namespace is only partially reconciled.
